# Shawn Pana

> Shawn Pana (@shawn_pana) is the solo founder and CEO of Phone Harness (YC F26), a harness that lets agents control your personal iPhone or Android phone.

## About

Shawn Pana studied Mathematics-Computer Science and Music at UC San Diego. He is a
multi-time hackathon winner and previously led growth at Browser Use (YC W25). He is now
the solo founder and CEO of Phone Harness (YC F26), a harness that lets agents control
your personal iPhone or Android phone. He also makes music.

## Projects

- [phone-harness](https://phone-harness.com): a harness that lets agents control your personal iPhone or Android phone.
- [browser-use](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use): the open-source library that lets AI agents control a browser.
- [smux](https://github.com/ShawnPana/smux): a tmux config with built-in terminal automation and agent-to-agent communication.
